services.name: Love’s Tubing
services.desc: Experience RIVERSPORT Rapids in a whole new way - tube down the rapids for a splashing good time. It’s fun and so easy, kids and adults alike enjoy the experience. Like our other adventures, we provide everything you’ll need including the tube and PFD (life jacket). Love’s Tubing is open daily with select hours on Saturdays during the summer. It’s a great way to get wet this summer and with your season membership you can come every day. Please note - secure footwear is required for all activities. No slides, flip flops or Crocs are allowed. You’ll find more important information here to ensure you have a great RIVERSPORT

services.name: Kayak Team
services.desc: RIVERSPORT group kayaking experiences are offered May to November. All group excursions have limited capacity and reservations are required. Are you a RIVERSPORT member? Enjoy one of each paddling experience free! Just enter the number on the back of your membership card at checkout. Join paddlers for this leisurely Saturday morning paddle at Lake Overholser, then kick back at the Trailhead Cafe for coffee, conversation - and breakfast if all that paddling whipped up your appetite. Includes kayak rental and a guide who leads the group. Grab a kayak and jump on the water as the sun breaks over the horizon in the Boathouse District. services.name: Bike Park
services.desc: RIVERSPORT’s newly expanded Trailhead Bike Park offers a mountain bike skills course plus three world-class mountain bike/BMX courses for the bike, skateboard and skate communities, as well as the Wheelhouse serving fresh Eote’ coffee, fruit smoothies and more. One of the more unique features of the project is a new elevated trail that travels across the rooftop of the shipping containers and a jump line that rivals the best in the country. The OKC Thunder NBA team even got in on the action with a Thunder branded feature! The Bike Park also serves as hub for the recently completed Greenway River Trails which encircle the city. services.name: Sunset Paddles
services.desc: Evening paddling excursions at Lake Overholser offer incredible sunsets and peaceful vibes as the sun sinks below the horizon. Includes your kayak rental and a guide who leads the group into the Stinchcomb Wildlife Refuge a short paddle away from the Lake Overholser

services.name: Surf OKC
services.desc: Get ready to surf - at RIVERSPORT in the Boathouse District! Grab a board and catch a wave on Surf OKC presented by TSET. With endless waves and a trampoline-like surface, this experience is perfect for all skill levels. No previous experience needed; you can take a lesson (see below) or just show up and give it a shot. Our surf staff can teach you all the basics. You start by bodyboarding, then go for the full flowboarding experience. If you’re a wakeboarder, skateboarder or snowboarder, you’ll be surfing in no time. Surf’s up! Join us for exclusive members-only hangtime on Surf OKC from 5-6p on Thursdays during the 2025 summer season. See excluded dates below. Discover Surfing lessons

blurb: RIVERSPORT’s Lake Overholser Boathouse is located on the east shore of Lake Overholser just south of the historic Route 66 bridge and offers access to the North Canadian River and Stinchcomb Wildlife Refuge for rowing, kayaking and stand up paddle boarding. The Trailhead Cafe offers drinks and snacks daily. You’ll find boathouse and Flat Tide rental hours
